tools.name: get_breaches
tools.description: Answers: Which public companies have disclosed a cybersecurity incident to the SEC? The reply opens with a one-line answer and its date. Breach Clock. SEC 8-K Item 1.05 · every filer · same day. Sourced from SEC EDGAR; every row links to its filing. Free, CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: get_cyber_disclosures
tools.description: Answers: Which public companies disclosed a cybersecurity incident voluntarily, without declaring it material? The reply opens with a one-line answer and its date. Cyber Disclosures. SEC 8-K Items 8.01 and 7.01 · cybersecurity incidents disclosed voluntarily · the filer’s own sentence. Sourced from

tools.name: get_charter_amendments

SEC 8-K Item 5.03 · articles, bylaws, fiscal year · renames flagged. Sourced from SEC EDGAR; every row links to its filing. Free, CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: get_mergers

SEC 8-K Items 2.01 and 5.01 · completed acquisitions and control changes. Sourced from SEC EDGAR; every row links to its filing. Free, CC BY 4

tools.name: get_agreements

tools.name: get_cmo_moves
